findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: neural_search · Private data: search_sealed_forecasts, get_advisory, list_open_calls, get_calibration_and_integrity, get_map, ask_the_record, neural_search, get_regrade_kit, get_luck_test, get_governance · Public sink: get_luck_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: neural_search · Private data: search_sealed_forecasts, get_advisory, list_open_calls, get_calibration_and_integrity, get_map, ask_the_record, neural_search, get_regrade_kit, get_luck_test, get_governance · Public sink: get_luck_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
